result.markdown:
**Verdict: Affirmative.**

Troy Jackson’s 2026 platform is more directly focused on lowering health care and prescription drug costs, strengthening workers’ rights, and shifting more of the tax burden onto wealthy individuals and corporations, giving it the stronger case for improving affordability for working-class Mainers, while Susan Collins’s emphasis on bipartisan experience and established legislative achievements offers a credible counterargument.
